title: Core domain and validation coverage
summary: Exercise PlanStore schemas, CRUD, references, lifecycle, repair, and persistence invariants.
description: Expand the existing packages/plan-core/test suite into a complete domain contract suite. Cover project initialization and loading; feature creation with valid, missing, empty, duplicate, and malformed fields; phase creation with feature ownership validation; task creation with phase ownership, shortName, global sequence, checklist, priority, and status validation; updates, deletes, reorder, requirements links, dependencies, tags/custom values where exposed by core, export/import, integrity, orphan cleanup, and generated output. Include positive and negative assertions for every schema and referential-integrity boundary. Verify status rollups, status history, display status, handoff replacement/archival, terminal-phase write rejection, repair cleanup, and restart persistence using isolated fixture directories. Preserve migration and backward-compatibility behavior while ensuring malformed input cannot partially write plan state.

Coperto:

- Checklist: addChecklistItem è PURO (non pusha — il caller appende), id deterministici (createChecklistItemId: <taskId>-check-<num>-<slug>), selettori C{n}/id/title esatto/parziale/case-insensitive, toggle esplicito+flip, remove con renumber 1..n, transform TaskSchema da stringhe, persistenza checked via reload; nesting = task.subtasks (ChecklistItemSchema NON ha parent — documentato).
- Reorder/midpoint: nextPriority scope (feature global max+1=31 su full; phase per-feature; task per-phase), midpoint insert tra vicini (floor((before+after)/2)) con ordine canonico (priority||number) persistito al reload, taskIds specchiato da normalizePhaseDocument, reindex fallback (i+1)*10 con gap esauriti.
- Links/dependencies: dependsOn round-trip su reload, refs malformati non corrompono load/render (writeGenerated ok), deletion-cleanup task → tasks+taskIds in lockstep.
- Backfill: ensureShortIdsAndPriority assegna shortId mancanti (Crockford 5-char, unici), NON sovrascrive esistenti, NON ri-prioritizza (identity), idempotente (2a run 0 assegnati), duplicati riportati non silenziosi (validateIntegrity concorda).

- Generated views: writeGenerated → PLAN.md + phases/<id>.md; checklist [x]/[ ] e ordine task canonico coerenti con loadAllPhases.

Fix durante lo sviluppo: addChecklistItem non muta l'array (3 asserzioni corrette); nextPriority su full = 31 (non 40); regex id checklist; dangling ref pruned on load (test riscritto su contract reale).

tasks.notes:
P053/F015 — T231 status rollups, handoff archival, repair, persistence. Progresso round 1 (in attesa review):

Deliverable: packages/plan-core/test/status-rollup-handoff-repair-persistence.test.mjs (7 test, fixture reali via test/helpers, zero mock, zero modifiche a UI/core).

Coperto:
- statusLog audit trail: syncTaskStatusRollup appende entry quando lo stato DERIVATO cambia (baseline "draft" → prima transizione), idempotente su sync ripetuti senza transizione, entries fromStatus/toStatus/title/date/id; rollup sul feature.statusLog (baseline "planned"); persistito via reopen.
- Handoff archival: task→done → syncTaskStatusRollup auto-clear con reason "phase-done", ritorna P001(F001); contenuto archiviato in .local/handoff-archive/<phaseId>-<ts>.md; handoffHistory entry {file,clearedAt,reason}; listArchivedHandoffs espone contenuto; listHandoffs esclude fasi done; cap a 5 con DELETE del file più vecchio; persistito via reopen.

GAP vs intent AGENTS.md ("no stale handoff after cancellation") — NON fixato (serve decisione prodotto), segnalato nel report come follow-up candidate.
- repair end-to-end: una sola repair() su fixture con handoff stale su phase done + shortId mancanti (feature+phase+task) → handoffs.archived=1, backfill.shortIdsAssigned=3, integrity {dup:[],dangling:[],dupshort:[]}; seconda repair no-op (idempotente); persistito via reopen.
- refreshResume: currentPhaseId/inProgressTaskIds/blockers seguono le transizioni (blocked task → blockers; all-done → inProgressTaskIds [] e blockers [], MA currentPhaseId RETAINED come contesto via existing fallback — contratto pinnato); resume.json persistito via reopen.

Fix durante sviluppo: backfill assegna shortId anche a phase+task (3, non 1); refreshResume conserva l'ultimo phaseId (assert allineato al contratto reale).

tasks.title: Correct coverage report threshold label for gated runs
tasks.description:
`scripts/report.mjs` renders the coverage heading as “Coverage (baseline thresholds)” unconditionally, while `scripts/test-all.mjs --gate` applies `COVERAGE.gate` final thresholds. Extend the report input or output metadata so HTML accurately identifies the threshold mode and values used by the run. Preserve deterministic report output, baseline behavior, existing JSON schema compatibility where possible, and the report test suite. Add regression coverage for both baseline and gated render modes. This follow-up was found during review of P052/T227 and is intentionally scheduled after the current active T230 work.

---
**Completion summary:**
Independent review approved. Corrected report metadata/rendering so baseline and final gated runs report the actual threshold mode and values: additive `thresholdMode`, correct `met` calculation, final-gate HTML/log labeling, and `test-all --gate` forwarding. Added baseline/gate CLI and determinism regressions while retaining schemaVersion 2 compatibility. Personally verified `test/report.test.mjs` 7/7 and `pnpm test` 258/258. No commit/push.
